title: Income Distribution Snapshot
description: Entitlements for one IncomeDistributor distribution. The server publishes RFC 8785 canonical bytes to IPFS; createDistribution records their SHA-256 and ipfs:// URI. merkleRoot is OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree.of(entries.map(e => [e.account, e.amount]), leafEncoding).root.

recordBlock.description: Block whose end-of-block balances define entitlements

total.description: Quote-token minimal units funded by createDistribution

eligibleSupply.description: Total supply at recordBlock minus the Vault's unsold inventory, in RWA minimal units

distributed.description: Sum of entry amounts; total minus distributed is rounding dust that stays until reclaimUnclaimed

entries.description: One entry per account with a positive amount, sorted by lowercase account hex ascending

account.description: EIP-55 holder address; escrowed RWA counts for the beneficiary of each Pending or Funded request

balance.description: Attributed RWA balance at recordBlock, in minimal units

amount.description: floor(total * balance / eligibleSupply) in quote-token minimal units
